the tree-like settling patterns of proppants were more likely to occur in the rough fractures with a high viscosity of fracturing fluids, a low injection rate, a high density of the propping materials, and a low proppant loading.

the proppant-filing ratio in a rough fracture could be maximized if the injection parameters (including the polymer concentration, injection velocity, proppant loading, and proppant density) were properly selected.

the injection rate should not be too low, and the polymer solution should not have too low viscosity, to avoid the injectivity issue.
